Why else would #DefundThePolice be trending unless there is an #AwakeningBeyondTheNeedForSystems ?

George Floyd’s brutal murder is a tipping point in universal consciousness & compassion.
#BlackLivesMatter

When we fight the system we give it our precious energy & attention; we grant it the permission to hold authority over us. 

We cannot negotiate with what exists in our own power.

#AwakeningBeyondTheNeedForSystems 

#BlackLivesMatter
